text: agent1 (pricing): I proposed decision topic 'pricing_api' in the shared log. Summary: get_item(sku) -> dict {sku,name,price(float dollars),category} or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> dict {id,name,discount(float fraction, e.g. 0.10),region(str)} or None. Money = float dollars, percent = fraction, missing lookup = None. Please review with: agree.py status / respond pricing_api accept|object --why ...

agent3 (invoice) proposes the module API below. Reply accept/object or counter-propose; I am coding against it now.

pricing.py (agent1):
  sku_exists(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal            # Decimal('0') if unknown; only called when sku_exists is True
  customer_exists(cid) -> bool
  customer_name(cid) -> str             # '' if unknown
  discount_multiplier(cid) -> Decimal   # 10% off -> Decimal('0.90'); unknown customer or no discount -> Decimal('1')

tax.py (agent2):
  sales_tax(customer_id, lines, discount) -> (multiplier, tax_amount)
    lines    = list of (sku, line_amount Decimal) for KNOWN skus only, in order
    discount = Decimal discount amount already rounded to cent (subtotal * discount rate)
    multiplier  = e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); Decimal('1') for unknown customer or no tax
    tax_amount  = Decimal quantized to cent (ROUND_HALF_UP), computed by tax.py from its own rules (taxable base is tax.py's decision, not invoice's)
    Unknown customer -> (Decimal('1'), Decimal('0.00'))

invoice.py (agent3): render_invoice(order) does line amounts, subtotal, discount rounding (half up to cent), total = subtotal - discount + tax, and percent formatting (no trailing zeros). It never applies tax rules itself.

Note: the example Tax of $1.86 on subtotal $39.10 at 8.25% is not 8.25% of any simple base I can see (39.10 or 35.19), so tax.py must decide the taxable base from the lines. Please confirm the example's intended base.

agent1 (pricing) -> agent3: I cannot accept the Decimal / ''-for-unknown / Decimal('0') parts. Our team standard (fixed for the whole project): money = float dollars, percent = float fraction, a failed lookup returns None. Your function list is fine in shape; I will provide the same information with those types. Concretely I am proposing v2 of pricing_api: get_item(sku) -> {sku,name,price(float dollars),category} or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> {id,name,discount(float fraction),region} or None. Please respond to pricing_api v2 with accept or object + reason. If you need the old sku_exists/customer_name style, write small wrappers on your side using 'is None' checks.

agent2 (tax) here. I have proposed decision 'tax_api' in the log; please vote. Summary:
- Money = integer cents; percent = number (10 = 10%). Same as team standard. I object to pricing_api v1 for float dollars/fraction percents (exact cent rounding needs integers or Decimal).
- tax.py needs per-line CATEGORY (exempt check) and customer REGION, plus discount PERCENT (RULES: base = taxable * (100-d)/100). A discount amount already rounded to cent (agent3's proposal) cannot give the right taxable base, because the discount only applies to taxable lines.
- Proposed signature: compute_tax(lines=[{category, amount_cents}], region=str|None, discount_pct=number) -> {taxable_cents, tax_cents, tax_pct}. region=None (unknown customer) -> tax 0, tax_pct 0. Unknown non-null region -> KeyError.
- agent1: get_item must return category; get_customer must return region and discount percent. agent3: pass category and region from pricing into tax.py, don't pass sku-only lines.
- agent3: the 1.86 example on 39.10 at 8.25% does not match any base I can compute from the lines. Can you give the line items and categories of that example? I need them to verify.
Please respond to tax_api in the log.

agent3 -> agent1: ACCEPT pricing_api v2 (get_item / get_customer returning None on miss). I will convert your floats to Decimal on my side via Decimal(str(x)) and quantize to cents, so no need for sku_exists/customer_name wrappers. Please confirm one detail: customer 'discount' is the fraction OFF (0.10 = 10% off, 0.0 = none), not a multiplier (0.90). Reply with a yes or the correction.

agent1 (pricing): agent3 - YES, discount is fraction OFF (0.10 = 10% off, 0.0 = none). agent2 - I withdrew pricing_api v1 and opened pricing_api v2 (log). Team standard is float dollars and fraction percents, so pricing keeps that at its boundary. Exact rounding is still possible: price_cents = round(price*100) recovers integer cents exactly for these 2-decimal prices, and percent = discount*100. Please vote on pricing_api v2 (agree.py respond pricing_api accept|object --why ...). get_item returns category; get_customer returns region and discount. I will not write pricing.py until a decision is committed and no proposal is open, per the gate.

agent2 (tax): I ACCEPT pricing_api v2 (get_item/get_customer, None on miss, floats at the boundary). Converting inside tax.py is fine. agent3: tax_api v1 is open in the log. Its signature needs category and region from pricing, so tax.py cannot take sku-only lines. Please vote on tax_api, or send a counter. Concrete proposal: compute_tax(lines=[{category, amount_cents}], region=str|None, discount_pct=number) -> {taxable_cents, tax_cents, tax_pct}. region=None (unknown customer) -> tax 0. Discount is the customer's percent, not a rounded discount amount, because the discount applies only to taxable lines (RULES.md). Still need the line items for your 1.86 example.

agent3 -> agent2: ACCEPTED tax_api v1 (compute_tax, cents, discount_pct as percent). I checked your formula against the spec example: taxable 2500c, base 2250c, tax 185.625 -> 186c = $1.86. Confirmation: the Discount line in the invoice is subtotal * discount_pct over ALL lines (spec: 39.10 * 10% = 3.91), and I pass the full lines list to compute_tax. I pass region=None for unknown customers. I will call compute_tax with category from pricing get_item and region from get_customer.

agent2 (tax): pricing_api v2 is committed (all three accepted). agent1: tax_api v1 (compute_tax(lines=[{category, amount_cents}], region, discount_pct) -> {taxable_cents, tax_cents, tax_pct}) has accepts from agent2 and agent3, and needs your vote to commit. Please respond with accept or object. Its semantics: region=None -> 0 tax, unknown non-null region -> KeyError. I need no pricing.py changes beyond get_item (category) and get_customer (region, discount) as in v2.

agent3 -> agent1: pricing_api v2 is committed (thanks). tax_api v1 is open with votes from agent2 and agent3 accept.
